sources.title: Qwen3.8 - How to Run Locally | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 is Qwen's new model family, featuring Qwen3.8- 27B, Qwen3.8- 2.4T-A95B and Qwen3.8- Max. Qwen3.8-27B has vision and reasoning capabilities, a 256K context window, and runs locally on 17GB RAM/VRAM setups. Qwen3.8 excels at agentic coding, vision and chat tasks, and can now run via Unsloth GGUFs, NVFP4 and Unsloth Desktop.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B - QwenCloud
sources.snippet: The Qwen3.8 27B native vision-language dense model builds upon the 3.6-27B version, with key improvements in coding and office productivity capabilities across both text and visual modalities. It enables more reliable end-to-end completion of complex tasks, delivering consistently trustworthy results.

sources.title: How to Run Qwen 3.8 Locally: 27B on 16-24GB GPUs (2026)
sources.snippet: What are you actually running? Qwen3.8-27B is a dense 27B vision-language model: text, images, and video (including hour-scale video) in one checkpoint, Apache-2.0 licensed. Native context is 262,144 tokens — the "extensible up to 1,000,000" line on the card refers to a Qwen Cloud hosted feature that is "coming soon", so plan around 256K locally.
